# P14.19 uses an item-specific local-source G-SECRET boundary

Source: [JSON](../../decisions/D128.json). This view is for people; agents use JSON through the Task API.

## Date

2026-09-26

## Status

accepted

## Decision

P14.19 declares the item-specific `[OWNER-GATE:G-SECRET-P14.19]`, retaining
`branch=main` and `scope=packages/api/config/corex-api.php`. Its Authority adds
`boundary=owner-session`, `effect=local-source` and `environment=checkout`.
The item remains limited to its declared Files, Validation and local source
effects. This amendment does not grant the gate and does not authorize real
secrets, live delivery, secret rotation, production migration, deployment,
release or external publication. The Task runtime still requires a fresh exact
owner `task:plan-run` invocation for P14.19 before protected product writes.

## Rationale

The local boundary matches the actual reversible checkout-only effect while
retaining an exact session-bound owner grant and preventing the generic
G-SECRET risk-class name from becoming a reusable cross-item grant.

## D128 — P14.19 uses an item-specific local-source G-SECRET boundary

**Actor:** owner / human, with plan-maintenance / codex-gpt-6-astra/high.

**Evidence:** `RAG:—` P14.19 changes only checkout PHP/config source and runs
synthetic/local validation. Its frozen Scope Excluded and Implementation Rules
forbid live webhook sends, real secret rotation, production migration, deployment
and release. The exact `task:plan-exec` invocation reached `AUTHORITY_BOUNDARY`
before durable start, and the Codex provider has no external verifier or nonce
store for the default `provider-proof` boundary
(`AUTHORITY_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE`). The owner then explicitly directed the plan
designer to perform the design correction and execution in the same root.

## Решение

P14.19 declares the item-specific `[OWNER-GATE:G-SECRET-P14.19]`, retaining

effects. This amendment does not grant the gate and does not authorize real
secrets, live delivery, secret rotation, production migration, deployment,
release or external publication. The Task runtime still requires a fresh exact
owner `task:plan-run` invocation for P14.19 before protected product writes.
